model: Ceph RADOS Gateway (beast frontend, single-node demo cluster: mon, mgr, directory OSD, rgw)

capture.setup: demo user `fxlab` with random access and secret keys; seeded with minio/mc: buckets inventory-exports (versioning enabled, 2 objects) and archive (default SSE-S3 configuration set; RGW without a KMS then refuses uploads, so the bucket stays empty)
capture.command: apps/collectors/cmd/object_storage invoked with target http://127.0.0.1:19900 (proxy keeping the Host header so SigV4 validates -> container :8080), options {pathStyle: true}, api_token credential with the demo user's keys; recording HTTP proxy (throwaway lab tool, not checked in) between the collector and the container; it stores each response status, Content-Type/Server/ETag headers and the body bytes unchanged; request Authorization headers are forwarded and never stored
